# SCHLÜSSELMACHER24 Architecture Blueprint

This document outlines the architectural objectives and constraints for the codebase auditing and blueprinting phase.

- Zero-New-Routes constraint is strictly enforced.
- The UI system uses Tailwind CSS v4 and the OKLCH Light Mode design doctrine.
- Interactive modules are implemented as Next.js Server Components.
- Refer to `.jules/architecture-matrix.md` and `.jules/revolution-plan.json` for specific route transformation plans.
